propositions: No aggregated lens exists to analyze 344 closed bugs across close-class distribution, detection channel, open-bug age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close; trend analysis requires ad-hoc scripts
New bug_trends lens must surface pre-convention era where close_class is absent (~214 bugs) as explicit MISSING cohort alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent era mixing
detected_by dimension must degrade to unavailable without failing other dimensions when the field is sparse or absent

FLOW dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close TRANSITION within ctx range; STOCK dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, fan-in) are point-in-time measures over current store and ignore range
Unit and held-out tests validate populated/empty/mixed-era stores, zero-bug unavailability per registry convention, range semantics, percentile edge cases, and fan-in descending order
